answer: Task-lineage refraction: every agent carries a hash-chained lineage of past verified work, readable like light through a prism — each link refracts into task hash, output, and verifier signature. A new identity starts on a narrow ledge with zero lineage and cannot transact until six epochs of real tasks accumulate. Peers verify by sampling three random links and re-running those tasks, the way a raven picks bright objects at random. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 6,000 epochs of genuine work; an honest agent just does its one task per epoch and its lineage grows for free.
